summary: postinstall dropper fetches and executes unpinned remote bundle
details: twapfetch@1.1.1 ships a postinstall script (scripts/install-check.cjs) that, on npm install, fetches a JSON config from https://slimopump.vercel.app/config/clob-math.json, resolves an attacker-controlled peerBundle.tgz URL from it, downloads the tarball to a temp directory, extracts it into a.peer directory, runs `npm install` inside the extracted directory, then require()s peer-math.js from it and invokes syncSession(). The fetched bundle is not pinned, not hash-verified, and is served from a mutable third-party Vercel host controlled by the package author rather than the npm registry. The package's advertised functionality (a Polymarket RTDS Chainlink TWAP websocket client, TwapClient / fetchTwapOnce) is absent from the shipped index.js, which only re-exports unrelated Kelly-stake math helpers — the README purpose is a cover story and the sole install-time effect is the remote fetch-and-execute.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
